Why this one

What stands out

A new platform, not a trim

The EL platform is a fresh, scalable architecture rather than a variant of the 450 or Rizta.

Aimed at the mass market

Ather's push into the volume segment currently held by petrol 110cc scooters.

Specs land on 29 August

Ather has deliberately held back the details until Community Day.
